clauses.requirement: Stop lamp geometric visibility: for S1 or S2 devices, horizontal angle 45° to the left and right of the vehicle longitudinal axis, except that for S1/S2 stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured per para 5.8.1) the inward 45° angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane; for S3 or S4 devices, 10° left and right of the longitudinal axis. Vertical angle: for S1 or S2, 15° above and below the horizontal, except (a) where mounted below 750 mm (per 5.8.1) the downward 15° may be reduced to 5°, and (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (per 5.8.1) the upward 15° may be reduced to 5°; for S3 or S4, 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
The electrical connections of the stop lamp shall comply with paragraphs 6.7.7.1 and 6.7.7.2.
All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
A stop lamp tell-tale is optional, but a tell-tale indicating failure shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
The stop lamp shall comply with the other requirements of paragraph 6.7.9, including paragraph 6.7.9.1.
A stop lamp of category S3 or S4 shall not be reciprocally incorporated with any other lamp.
